newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria stiffens borders against oil smugglers.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria stiffens borders against oil smugglers.

text.p: Bulgaria, heavily hit by fuel shortages, stiffened border controls on Friday to prevent oil smuggling, interim prime minister Stefan Sofianski told reporters.
"From today we ban any fuel exports and if necessary we will have troops on borders but we must stop speculations with fuel," Sofianski said.
The ban does not affect the country's biggest oil refinery Neftohim, he added.

Motorists smuggle cans full of petrol or diesel to neighbouring Yugoslavia and Macedonia, where prices are higher, while fuel shortages threaten to paralyse Bulgaria due to a lack of cash for crude oil.

Shortages have closed most Bulgarian petrol stations and municipalities are distributing petrol and diesel for ambulances, bread and food trucks, the police, army and other social services, officials said.
Bus transport in towns has been strongly reduced causing problems for industry, transport ministry officials said.
